hypothesis.statement: On real eyes-closed 64-channel EEG (eegmmidb S002R02), eegComplexity's Hjorth mobility + complexity reproduce an independent numpy implementation (matched unbiased variance) bit-for-bit and antropy.hjorth_params to machine precision up to its biased-variance (ddof) convention, across all channels; and mobility is lowest over the posterior (parieto-occipital) region where the eyes-closed alpha rhythm dominates (slow oscillation = low mobility).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), all 64 EEG channels, first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the Hjorth mobility + complexity equal an independent numpy implementation (unbiased n-1 variance) to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-10) across all 64 channels, and antropy.hjorth_params to < 1e-5 (up to its biased-variance convention), AND mobility is lowest over the posterior alpha region
